During Q3, he loaded up on Space Exploration Technologies (NASDAQ:SPCX) shares. He owned barely any at the end of Q2 (SpaceX went public right before Q2 ended), but as of the end of Q3, it was the fourth-largest position in his portfolio, accounting for nearly 8% of its value. That shows extreme confidence in the stock, but should you follow suit and open a position in it? Missed Nvidia in 2009? This Rare Signal Is Flashing Again. items.originalTitle: Oil Prices Fall as Traders Weigh Supply Surplus, Gulf Attacks
items.originalSummary: Oil prices slipped in early Asian trading on Wednesday, November 25, as traders seemed to balance signs of growing supply against a run of attacks on ships near the Strait of Hormuz.Brent crude fell to $90.96 a barrel after closing above $91 on Monday, while West Texas Intermediate for January delivery dropped 0.5% to $81.65, extending a pullback after a 2.4% gain in the previous session.Iran's Fars news agency reported on Tuesday that a mine had struck a fourth tanker, adding to a string of vessels Iran has targeted recently. Tehran also plans to tighten its control over Hormuz until its demands are met, which shows how far the nearly nine-month conflict is from resolution, according to a report by the country's Tasnim News.Also Read: China, India set for record Russian oil imports in 2026, but demand seen peakingCrude exports from the Gulf region have, however, surged in recent months, and the International Energy Agency expects the market to swing into surplus this quarter. Brent has tumbled this month, partly because President Donald Trump held off on fresh strikes against Iran after the US midterm elections.On the diplomatic front, US Vice President JD Vance and Secretary of State Marco Rubio met Qatar's prime minister, Sheikh Mohammed bin Abdulrahman bin Jassim Al Thani, separately on Monday as per an AP report. Qatar has played a key role in efforts to revive stalled talks to end the conflict.The report, citing an anonymous person familiar with the matter, said Vance held talks with the prime minister at the White House. Rubio met him for the biannual US-Qatar Strategic Dialogue, which covers a broad range of regional security issues, including Iran.The meetings came after Trump told Vance the administration did not need a deal with Iran and instructed him to focus on fraud and crime in Democratic-led cities, following the Republican Party's heavy losses in this month's midterms. Vance, who had led negotiations on a brief ceasefire, has blamed voter unhappiness with the Iran war for those losses.Trump has also left allies in the conflict struck region guessing about his next move, and many fear a return to all-out war. He said he saw no need to resume major operations, although both sides continue to carry out sporadic bursts of military action and the US maintains its naval blockade on Iranian shipping in the strait.At a White House news conference on Friday, Trump had said that Tehran wants an agreement but not one he finds acceptable. "We want to make a real deal, not a fake deal," he said.With Agency Inputs

historyItems.title: 亞馬遜將於 2027 年初在英國推出 Amazon Autos，這是其首次向美國以外擴張
historyItems.summary: 亞馬遜（AMZN，財經）週三表示，將於 2027 年初將其線上汽車市場擴展到英國，這是該服務首次擴展到美國以外的地區。現代汽車將成為首批合作夥伴之一，提供一系列新車和二手電動、混合動力和汽油車，包括 IONIQ 3、IONIQ 5、KONA 和 i20 車型。英國汽車經銷商 Vertu Motors 也將在該網站上列出二手車。客戶將能夠在亞馬遜英國網站上搜尋車輛、查看前期定價、預訂汽車、獲取指示性以舊換新估值並查看融資替代方案。參與的經銷商將保留對車輛定價的控制權，並將進行所有最終購買交易。亞馬遜於 12 月在美國推出了汽車市場
historyItems.originalTitle: Amazon to launch Amazon Autos in UK in early 2027 in first expansion beyond US
historyItems.originalSummary: Amazon ( AMZN , Financials ) said Wednesday it will expand its online vehicle marketplace to the United Kingdom in early 2027, the service's first expansion beyond the United States.Hyundai Motor will be among the first partners, offering a range of new and used electric, hybrid and petrol cars, including its IONIQ 3, IONIQ 5, KONA and i20 models.Vertu Motors, the British car dealer, will also list used cars on the site.Customers will be able to search for vehicles, see upfront pricing, reserve cars, get indicative trade-in valuations and look at financing alternatives on Amazon's UK site.Dealers participating will retain control of vehicle pricing and will conduct all final purchase transactions.Amazon launched its car marketplace in the US in December 2024 and has since expanded the service to over 150 cities.Amazon's e-commerce business is branching out internationally into another big consumer spending category but retaining agreements with existing auto dealerships.The corporation did not provide financial predictions for the British market.Amazon said it intends to announce more auto brands and dealership partners in the coming months, ahead of an expected debut.

historyItems.summary: 舊金山 49 人隊和 Meta 今天宣佈建立具有里程碑意義的多年合作夥伴關係，並任命 Meta 為 NFL 球隊的官方時刻製造者。這項合作關係建立在創新和創造有意義的生活記憶的共同承諾之上，將兩個灣區誕生的組織聯合起來，共同打造體育迷體驗的未來。作為此次合作的重點，49 人隊和 Meta 計劃向所有 49 人隊套房合作夥伴和俱樂部季票會員贈送一副免費的 Oakley Meta HSTN AI 眼鏡，以慶祝 49 人隊成立 80 週年。透過這項舉措，超過 4,700 名會員將直接在家中獲得 Meta 的下一代技術，為他們帶來前所未有的 VIP 體驗。
historyItems.originalTitle: 49ers and Meta Announce Multi-Year Partnership Centered Around Meta AI Glasses
historyItems.originalSummary: The San Francisco 49ers and Meta today announced a landmark multi-year partnership, naming Meta the Official Moment Maker of the NFL franchise. Built on a shared commitment to innovate and create meaningful memories for life, the partnership unites two Bay Area-born organizations for the future of the sports fan experience. Headlining the partnership, the 49ers and Meta plan to gift all 49ers suite partners and club season ticket members a free pair of Oakley Meta HSTN AI glasses to celebrate the 49ers 80th anniversary. Through this initiative, more than 4,700 members will receive Meta’s next-gen technology directly to their homes, giving them a first-of-its-kind VIP experience. Oakley Meta HSTN AI glasses allow fans to capture their fan experience through photos and videos hands-free, listen to music, and get help from Meta AI, all while staying in the moment “Innovation and technology are part of our franchise’s DNA, from the West Coast offense, to Levi’s® Stadium, to the future of the fan experience,” said Brent Schoeb, 49ers Chief Operating Officer. “Meta has been at the forefront of technology for a long time. That, paired with being Silicon Valley neighbors, made this partnership a perfect fit. We are thrilled to continue providing members with exclusive benefits and look forward to seeing the content they create with Meta’s AI glasses.” In addition to gifting thousands of Meta AI glasses, Meta has joined the 49ers global marketing efforts in the UK, UAE, and Mexico as part of the NFL’s Global Markets Program. Over the next several years, Meta will support the team’s mission to reach new fans, grow the game of American football, and leave a lasting impact on international communities. As a first step, WhatsApp, owned by Meta, has been named the Official Instant Messenger Provider of the 49ers, enabling fast and efficient communication globally for the team. “Game day is about being in the moment from the tailgate to victory and the best way to capture it all is handsfree with Oakley Meta glasses. As a lifelong member of the 49ers Faithful, I’m fired up that we are now an official partner and will help connect fans to the team we love,” said Andrew Bosworth, Chief Technology Officer at Meta. Meta and the 49ers plan to explore additional opportunities to integrate technology and AI across the organization. This season, 49ers fans can also look forward to seeing 49ers FB Kyle Juszczyk sport Meta AI glasses as a brand ambassador in a new campaign. For more information, please visit 49ers.com.

historyItems.title: 現場報告：SpaceX 將為美國太空軍發射機密有效載荷
historyItems.summary: 在 NROL-179 任務發射之前，一枚 SpaceX 獵鷹 9 號火箭停泊在范登堡太空部隊基地 4 號東部太空發射綜合體 (SLC-4E)。圖片來源：SpaceX SpaceX 的獵鷹 9 號火箭正準備在週二上午代表美國太空軍從加州范登堡太空部隊基地將機密有效載荷送入軌道。 USSF-266 任務將是 SpaceX 本月啟動的第五項政府任務，其中四項是為太空部隊執行的，另一項是為國家偵察辦公室執行的。
historyItems.originalTitle: Live coverage: SpaceX to launch classified payload for the U.S. Space Force
historyItems.originalSummary: A SpaceX Falcon 9 rocket stands at Space Launch Complex 4 East (SLC-4E) at Vandenberg Space Force Base ahead of the launch of the NROL-179 mission. Image: SpaceX A SpaceX Falcon 9 rocket is being readied to send a classified payload to orbit Tuesday morning from Vandenberg Space Force Base in California on behalf of the U.S. Space Force. The USSF-266 mission will be the fifth government mission launched by SpaceX this month, four for the Space Force and one for the National Reconnaissance Office. Liftoff from Space Launch Complex 4 East is scheduled during a window that opens at 7:55 a.m. PST (10:55 a.m. EST / 1555 UTC). Spaceflight Now will have live coverage beginning about 30 minutes prior to liftoff. SpaceX will launch the mission using the Falcon 9 first stage booster B1081, which is making its 29th launch. Its previous flights included NASA’s Crew-7, PACE, and TRACERS missions. Less than 8.5 minutes after liftoff, B1081 will target a landing on the droneship, Of Course I Still Love You , positioned in the Pacific Ocean. A successful recovery would mark the 236th landing on this vessel and the 681st booster landing to date. USSF-266 is the third in a series of missions using the ‘TH’ designation in public filings. Previous flights is this sequence were USSF-259/TH-1 on Sept. 16 and USSF-481/TH-2 on Oct. 15. Following each of those missions, 17 satellites were added into the orbital tracking catalogue maintained by the Space Force. historyItems.originalSummary: A SpaceX Falcon 9 rocket lifts off from Space Launch Complex 4 East at Vandenberg Space Force Base on the USSF-266 mission on Nov. 24, 2026. Image: SpaceX A SpaceX Falcon 9 rocket launched Tuesday morning from Vandenberg Space Force Base in California on behalf of the U.S. Space Force. The USSF-266 mission was the fifth government mission launched by SpaceX this month, four for the Space Force and one for the National Reconnaissance Office. Liftoff from Space Launch Complex 4 East happened at at 8:08 a.m. PST (11:08a.m. EST / 1608 UTC). SpaceX launched the mission using the Falcon 9 first stage booster B1081, which is making its 29th launch. Its previous flights included NASA’s Crew-7, PACE, and TRACERS missions. Less than 8.5 minutes after liftoff, B1081 landed on the droneship, Of Course I Still Love You , positioned in the Pacific Ocean. This marked the 236th landing on this vessel and the 681st booster landing to date. USSF-266 was the third in a series of missions using the ‘TH’ designation in public filings. Previous flights is this sequence were USSF-259/TH-1 on Sept. 16 and USSF-481/TH-2 on Oct. 15. Following each of those missions, 17 satellites were added into the orbital tracking catalogue maintained by the Space Force. That award was announced back in late July by the Space Force’s Space Systems Command. This task order was established through the National Security Space Launch (NSSL) Phase 3 Lane 1 contract, which is designed to allow for a wide range of launch providers to bid on and receive task orders for payloads that can shoulder a higher risk tolerance. “We have set an unprecedented two-month acquisition timeline under the Phase 3 Lane 1 contract from requirement identification to award,” said said Space Force Col. Eric Zarybnisky, acting portfolio acquisition executive for Space Access at the time of the award. “This includes the one-month period for the launch service providers’ proposal preparation. Ultimately, this timeline results in the speed our warfighter demands more than ever before.”

historyItems.originalTitle: HPE Lifts Outlook as AI Demand Boosts Revenue, Profit
historyItems.originalSummary: Server maker Hewlett-Packard Enterprise Co. posted its fastest quarterly revenue growth on record and raised its full-year forecast, but it wasn’t enough to keep up the momentum of a broader Nvidia Corp.-fueled rally, and its stock was headed lower after-hours. The company reported fourth-quarter earnings before certain costs such as stock compensation of $1.43 per share, easily beating Wall Street’s target of $1.26 per share. Revenue for the period rose 50% from the same period one year earlier, to $14.55 billion, surpassing the Street’s $14.47 billion estimate. HPE also recorded a net profit of $1.82 billion, up from just $175 million in the year-ago period. The stunning revenue growth was a reflection of the enormous demand for artificial intelligence servers and networking equipment, said President and Chief Executive Antonio Neri (pictured). “Our record performance reflects the portfolio we have built to drive durable, profitable growth for our shareholders,” he said in a statement. HPE said it’s raising its revenue expectations for fiscal 2027, which ends next October, saying it’s now targeting growth of between 27% to 35%, or sales of between $59.4 billion and $63.1 billion. Previously, the company had been looking for growth of just 13% to 17%. Neri told analysts on a conference call that the updated guidance reflects the growing demand the company is seeing for AI servers that extends well into next year. He said the company has a strong position as the AI industry shifts from a focus on training models to supporting inference workloads and AI agents. “We have a perfect portfolio to capture that inflection point across networking, cloud and AI,” Neri said, citing “the durability of the demand and the durability of our execution now with a completely different setup in our portfolio.” According to Neri, the improved outlook also reflects the company’s view that the supply of key components such as memory, flash and networking equipment will remain constrained through to the end of calendar 2028. Despite the impressive forecast, HPE couldn’t sustain the momentum of an Nvidia-inspired rally that helped its stock jump more than 17% in regular trading before the earnings report. AI stocks in general received a huge boost earlier today on the news that the chipmaker has reinstated its founder and CEO Jensen Huang . But HPE fell more than 6% after-hours. For the current quarter, HPE is looking for revenue of between $14 billion and $14.6 billion, which would represent growth of 54% at the middle of that forecast. That suggests its revenue growth is going to accelerate and set a new company record. That forecast is strong too, with Wall Street analysts looking for first-quarter sales of just $13 billion. HPE’s biggest rival in the AI server business, Dell Technologies Inc., is expected to announce its own earnings results tomorrow afternoon, along with HP, Nutanix and Workday.

historyItems.originalTitle: SpaceX launches intelligence-gathering satellites for the National Reconnaissance Office
historyItems.originalSummary: A Falcon 9 rocket stands poised to launch from the Space Launch Complex 4E at Vandenberg Space Force Base in California. File Photo: SpaceX Update Nov. 22, 8 a.m. EST (1300 UTC): SpaceX landed its booster at Landing Zone 4. SpaceX launched a batch of intelligence-gathering satellites to low Earth orbit on behalf of the National Reconnaissance Office on Sunday morning. Its Falcon 9 rocket took off from Vandenberg Space Force Base in California, smashing the pad turnaround record at the site by more than 23 hours. Liftoff from Space Launch Complex 4E at Vandenberg Space Force Base is scheduled for 4:23 a.m. PST (7:23 a.m. EST / 1223 UTC). It came 32 hours, 3 minutes, and 21 seconds after the launch of the USSF. The previous turnaround was set back in June at 55 hours, 48 minutes, and 21 seconds. Prior to Sunday morning, SpaceX’s overall pad turnaround record was 45 hours, set by back-to-back Starlink flights from Cape Canaveral Space Force Base in Florida in January. The mission, designated NROL-136, will add an undisclosed number of satellites to the NRO’s satellite constellation that it refers to as its proliferated architecture. This was the fourth such launch this year and the 15th to date. SpaceX launched the mission using the Falcon 9 first stage booster with the tail number B1097. This was its 14th flight following the launches of NROL-172, USSF-259, Transporter-17, Twilight, Sentinel-6B, and eight batches of Starlink satellites. Roughly 7.5 minutes after liftoff, B1097 touched down at Landing Zone 4, adjacent to the launch pad. This was the 38th landing at this site and the 680th Falcon booster landing to date.

historyItems.summary: 週四，紐約市居民在打開亞馬遜應用程式時可能會看到一個新的彈出窗口，警告顧客，市議會的一項法案可能意味著每個訂單的送貨成本可能會上漲 5 美元。該應用程式主頁上的廣告連結到一個表格，供亞馬遜客戶聯繫其市議會成員並要求他們停止《送貨保護法》。該法案的發起人、議員蒂芙尼·卡班 (Tiffany Caban) 表示：“這個常識性的法案從來不會讓亞馬遜每次送貨都要花費 5 美元，所以這就是企業欺凌行為。試圖用垃圾費嚇唬紐約人。”
historyItems.originalTitle: Amazon Urges NYC Customers to Oppose Mamdani-Backed Delivery Bill
historyItems.originalSummary: New York City residents may have seen a new pop up when opening their Amazon app on Thursday, warning customers that a city council bill could mean the cost of their deliveries could go up $5 per order. The ad on the app's homepage links to a form for Amazon customers to contact their city council member and request they stop the Delivery Protection Act. "There’s no world where this common sense bill costs Amazon $5 for every delivery, so what this is is corporate bullying. Trying to scare New Yorkers with junk fees," said Councilmember Tiffany Caban, who sponsored the bill.

historyItems.originalTitle: I tested the Alexa Tablet 8 for a week. It’s Amazon’s best attempt at an iPad yet
historyItems.originalSummary: Testing the Amazon Alexa Tablet 8 felt like I was giving an ex a second chance because they fixed a couple of the character flaws that made me block their number in the first place. Amazon’s new tablets are shiny, metallic and feel premium, things you couldn’t say about the Fire tablets they replace. Even more importantly, Amazon finally fixed one of its biggest tablet sins that had always stopped them from being considered the best tablet in any category other than budget or for kids. So, how does the new entry-level Alexa Tablet 8 (and its bigger siblings) stack up against the Apple iPad 11? I spent the last few weeks digging into the new family of Amazon tablets to see how they compare to the king, and finding out who they’re actually for. Here’s what I learned. Amazon Alexa Tablet 8 Amazon’s replacement for the Fire tablets offers a stylish metallic design and actual Google Play Store support that finally brings YouTube and Chrome over. $230 From $130 at Amazon $230 From $150 at Best Buy What I liked about it Out of Fire’s ashes, colorful metallic shells offer a great design Having tested tablets for the better part of my 11-plus years writing tech product reviews, I’m happy to say that Amazon’s built one of the best-looking iPad clones I’ve ever seen. And I mean that as a compliment. Gone are the days of Amazon’s cheap, disposable plastic Fire tablets, replaced by shiny, metallic Alexa tablets, whose backs pick up the sunlight in delightful ways and exude the look of top Android tablets. From the bold colors — I really like the teal aluminum shell of my Alexa Tablet 8 — to their sturdy frames, these slates offer the best builds I’ve ever seen from Amazon’s Android tablet division. I prefer the color I tested, but Amazon also offers a Graphite black for those who like to blend into the crowd and a light purple Rosette design that I can’t knock either. Amazon finally accepts Google Play and real Android The Amazon Fire tablets’ biggest sin was one of omission, as they never had the Google Play Store and forced users to rely on Amazon’s own app ecosystem that didn’t have Gmail, YouTube and many other popular apps. This was the kind of mistake that had me saying very dismissive and unkind things about those tablets. Thankfully, Amazon’s reached the end of that error, which is great for everyone who wanted Chrome so they wouldn’t have to rely on Amazon’s slow and poorly designed Silk web browser. The Alexa Tablet 8 and its siblings run a very Alexa-infused version of Android 16 that promotes your own Amazon ecosystem content (such as Kindle e-books) in the top corner, and a whole “Ask Alexa” widget affixed to the bottom corner. While I was a bit hesitant about these integrations when I first started testing, I’ve come to see that they’re great ways to easily pick up where you left off in novels and shows or ask Alexa a quick question. As someone who is always reluctant to use voice assistants (especially their AI-based counterparts), I’m surprised that I’ve already found a place where Alexa+ impressed me. historyItems.originalTitle: Space Exploration Technologies Corp. (SPCX) Stock Price, News, Quote & History
historyItems.originalSummary: SpaceX (SPCX) got a clear fundamental lift after reporting third-quarter revenue of $14.6 billion, above the LSEG consensus estimate of $12.7 billion, with adjusted earnings of 45 cents per share versus a 13-cent forecast, according to CNBC on October 21, 2026. CNBC also reported that shares surged 8% after the release, while Reuters via NBC News said the stock rose 2.5% in extended trading as revenue more than doubled on the company’s surging AI business. Despite the post-earnings reaction, the current price is $130.03, which sits below the 7-day SMA at $136.23, the 20-day SMA at $136.82, and the 50-day SMA at $146.14. That is a bearish moving-average stack: short, medium and intermediate trend are all still pointing lower. Momentum is not confirming a clean reversal yet. The 14-day RSI is 41.07, which is neutral but weak. MACD is negative at -2.8815, and the histogram is flat at 0.0000, which suggests momentum has stopped accelerating lower but has not turned constructive. Stochastic readings are pinned near oversold territory, with %K at 11.29 and %D at 9.03, so the stock is stretched, but not necessarily repaired. The immediate levels are tight. Strong resistance is 131.94, just above the current price, with immediate resistance at 130.99. Pivot is 130.33, almost exactly where the stock is trading. On the downside, immediate support is 129.38 and strong support is 128.72. Bollinger Bands frame the same picture. The lower band is 125.97, the middle band is 136.82, and %B is 0.1871, which places SPCX near the lower band. That usually signals compression near support, but it does not by itself confirm a base. Average true range is 7.10, which means this name can move fast enough to erase a tight setup quickly. The 24-hour range of 131.29 to 129.68 shows the tape is still relatively contained, while 24-hour volume of $80.4 million on Binance Futures suggests active trading interest rather than a thin, illiquid drift.

historyItems.originalTitle: Applied Materials Earnings Recap: Strong Results and Guidance Point to Solid Year Ahead
historyItems.originalSummary: Applied Materials reported record Q4 2026 results, with sales of US$10.4b and net income of US$2.7b. The company also issued revenue guidance of US$11.1b for Q1 fiscal 2027, supported by AI chip and equipment demand. The company is tying these strong fundamentals to long term equipment partnerships and its EPIC Center expansion. It is aiming to capture higher value opportunities in advanced packaging, diagnostics, and services linked to AI focused manufacturing. We will now look at how Applied Materials' record quarterly earnings and raised revenue outlook interact with its longer term investment narrative.

historyItems.originalTitle: SpaceX launches satellites for the U.S. Space Force’s data network constellation
historyItems.originalSummary: A SpaceX Falcon 9 rocket flies away from Space Launch Complex 4 East at Vandenberg Space Force Base on the USSF-317 mission on Nov. 20, 2026. Image: SpaceX Update Nov. 21: U.S. Space Force confirmed the payload for the mission. SpaceX launched an undisclosed number of satellites on a Falcon 9 rocket on behalf of the U.S. Space Force on Friday night. SpaceX scrubbed the launch Thursday night, but didn’t state the reason why. The mission, designated USSF-317, flew from Space Launch Complex 4 East at Vandenberg Space Force Base at 8:20 p.m. PST / 11:20 p.m. EST (0420 UTC on Saturday, Nov. 21). The rocket took off on a south-easterly trajectory upon leaving the pad. Following deployment, the government issued a short statement, confirming publicly for the first time the intention of a series of missions launched this year that have received an ‘R’ designation in public filings. “With three successful launches in two weeks, the Department of the Air Force is accelerating the development and launch of the Space Data Network Backbone constellation, advancing a government-owned and controlled communication system that will provide secure, high-speed data transport globally for the Joint Force,” said the Secretary of the Air Force Public Affairs in a press release. “The accelerated schedule is on track to deliver regional capability this year and global support by next year.” The Space Data Network (SDN) Backbone comes from the Portfolio Acquisition Executive (PAE) of the Space-Based Sensing and Targeting (SBST), an acquisition office within the Space Force. Back in May, the Space Force announced its award of a $2.29 billion contract to SpaceX to build a satellite constellation that “functions as an integrated network, providing robust, resilient, high-capacity, and low-latency data transport for the Joint Force.” The Space Force said back in May that the SDN Backbone would operate alongside the Space Development Agency’s Transport Layer, a constellation of data relaying satellites manufactured by Lockheed Martin, Northrop Grumman, and York Space Systems. historyItems.summary: Kratos Defense & Security Solutions (KTOS) 剛剛推出了 KnownSpace Recon+，這是一款便攜式衛星終端，將多個射頻空間域感知工具打包到一個現場就緒單元中，多個美國政府機構已經訂購了該終端。 Kratos Defense & Security Solutions 一直在忙碌，而市場情緒則相反，在新的太空和導彈預警合約、海上發射計劃和新的指引發布後，1 天股價回報率下跌 2.64％，7 天股價回報率下跌 17.58％。短期內跌幅較大，30日股價報酬率下跌22.80%，90日股價報酬率下跌46.17%，年初至今股價報酬率下跌61.86%。
historyItems.originalTitle: Kratos Defense & Security Solutions (KTOS) Stock Dropped, What Is Behind The Latest Attention?
historyItems.originalSummary: Kratos Defense & Security Solutions (KTOS) just rolled out KnownSpace Recon+, a portable satellite terminal that packs multiple radio frequency space domain awareness tools into a single field-ready unit already ordered by several U.S. government agencies. Kratos Defense & Security Solutions has been busy on the ground while sentiment in the market has gone the other way, with the 1-day share price return down 2.64% and the 7-day move down 17.58% on the heels of new space and missile warning contracts, offshore launch plans, and fresh guidance. The slide has been steep in the short term, with the 30-day share price return down 22.80% and the 90-day move down 46.17%, and the year-to-date share price return down 61.86%. Yet longer history tells a different story, as the 3-year total shareholder return is up 58.74% and the 5-year total shareholder return is up 46.02%, suggesting long-run holders have still seen gains even as recent momentum has clearly faded.

historyItems.summary: 您不僅需要專注於源自 CRM 的客戶訊息，還需要專注於來自其他系統（例如客戶支援軟體）的支援數據。如果您的數據不準確或雜亂無章，您就無法與客戶進行可靠的溝通，這意味著收入損失。確保良好的數據品質需要測試和持續警惕。根據員工規模，您可能需要雇用某人來管理所有資料管理任務，包括自動化工作流程、備份和保護。
historyItems.originalTitle: The Best CRM Software We've Tested for 2026
historyItems.originalSummary: You need to pay attention not only to customer information originating in the CRM but also to supporting data from other systems, such as your customer support software . You can't reliably communicate with customers if your data is inaccurate or disorganized, which means lost revenue. Ensuring good data quality is a matter of testing and constant vigilance. Depending on the size of your staff, you might need to hire someone to manage all data management tasks, including automating workflows, backup , and protection. If you feel such a hire is in your future, involve that person in your CRM search as early as possible. When you work with customer data, security should be top of mind. It's a warning sign when your CRM doesn't generate an audit trail whenever someone changes a password, or if it doesn't let you define access controls for each user. Customer data is extremely valuable, especially now that customers are more reluctant to part with it. Securing it isn't just about maintaining privacy; it's about protecting profitable relationships. You should ensure that your CRM software integrates with as much of your current IT security stack as possible, including your identity management system, so your employees can use single sign-on (SSO) or multi-factor authentication . But you also need to closely evaluate a vendor's policies to ascertain exactly where your data resides, who is responsible for its safety, and what happens if there's a problem. Search for any past breaches and how the company responded to them as well.

historyItems.summary: Nason 在技術、策略和企業財務領域擁有數十年的全球經驗 休斯敦，2026 年 11 月 18 日 --(美國商業資訊)--HPE (NYSE: HPE) 今天宣布任命 Jennifer Nason 為其董事會成員，任命即日生效。 Nason 憑藉多年的全球投資銀行經驗，帶來了技術、策略和企業融資方面深厚的專業知識。她擁有為全球技術、媒體和電信公司提供諮詢服務的背景，這使她擅長將公司策略與市場趨勢聯繫起來，在網路、雲端和人工智慧重塑企業技術格局之際，為慧與帶來寶貴的視角。
historyItems.originalTitle: HPE Adds Former JPMorgan Exec to Board, Amends Agreement With Elliott Investment
historyItems.originalSummary: Nason brings decades of global experience spanning technology, strategy, and corporate finance HOUSTON, November 18, 2026 --( BUSINESS WIRE )--HPE (NYSE: HPE) today announced the appointment of Jennifer Nason to its Board of Directors, effective today. Nason brings deep expertise in technology, strategy, and corporate finance from her many years of global investment banking experience. Her background advising technology, media, and telecommunications companies globally has made her adept at connecting company strategy with market trends, bringing valuable perspective to HPE as networking, cloud, and AI reshape the enterprise technology landscape.

historyItems.title: 華碩、戴爾和 MSI 今天推出首款 Nvidia RTX Spark 迷你電腦
historyItems.summary: 繼今年稍早推出首款 RTX Spark 筆記型電腦後，Nvidia 的 RTX Spark N1X 晶片現在也出現在華碩、戴爾和 MSI 的桌上型電腦中。宏碁、技嘉和惠普稍後將推出更多 RTX Spark 桌上型電腦，而微軟的 Surface RTX Spark Dev Box 則定於本月開始出貨。新款迷你電腦配備 6144 核心 Nvidia Blackwell RTX GPU、20 核心 Nvidia Grace CPU 和高達 128GB 的​​記憶體。這款高階硬體的價格也與之相匹配——華碩的 ProArt GR1X 起價為 4,499 美元，配備 64GB 記憶體和 1TB 儲存空間。
historyItems.originalTitle: The first Nvidia RTX Spark mini PCs launch today from Asus, Dell, and MSI
historyItems.originalSummary: After the first RTX Spark laptops launched earlier this year, Nvidia’s RTX Spark N1X chip is also now available in desktops from Asus, Dell, and MSI . More RTX Spark desktops are coming later from Acer, Gigabyte, and HP, while Microsoft’s Surface RTX Spark Dev Box is slated to start shipping this month. The new mini PCs include a 6144-core Nvidia Blackwell RTX GPU, 20-core Nvidia Grace CPU, and up to 128GB of memory. That high-end hardware comes with a price to match — Asus’s ProArt GR1X starts at $4,499 for a configuration with 64GB of memory and 1TB of storage. Like the RTX Spark laptops that compete with the MacBook Pro and the DGX Spark desktop Nvidia launched last year, the new mini PCs are Mac Mini or Mac Studio alternatives for developers working with local AI models, as well as RTX-accelerated software. That includes the AI-powered features for tools like Adobe Premiere and Photoshop, and new DLSS 4.5 Ray Reconstruction support in Blender 5.3. They can run games too , and Windows on Arm game support is improving, but at these prices, that’s not a realistic reason to pick one up yet. Nvidia says they can act as a “dedicated Windows PC for local models and always-on agents,” and deliver “up to 1 petaflop of AI performance.” They also feature native CUDA support and access to Linux development tools through Windows Subsystem for Linux.

historyItems.originalTitle: Michael Douglas and Catherine Zeta-Jones’ Sweetest Family Photos
historyItems.originalSummary: Catherine Zeta-Jones and Michael Douglas ‘ love was clearly written in the stars. Not only are the two some of the most talented actors in Hollywood, but the pair also shares a birthday, which is a rarity in itself. Douglas was born Sept. 25, 1944, in New Brunswick, New Jersey, while Zeta-Jones was born on the same day in 1969, in Wales. Despite their age difference, the couple have been married for almost three decades and are still going strong. Douglas and Zeta-Jones welcomed their first child together, son Dylan, in 2000, before adding to their family with the arrival of daughter Carys in 2002. Douglas is also dad to son Cameron, whom he welcomed with ex-wife Diandra Luker. See Catherine Zeta-Jones and Michael Douglas’ sweet family photos as they celebrate 26 years of marriage on Nov. 18, 2026.

historyItems.summary: 退伍军人事务部发出两张传票，将 Oracle Health 电子健康记录合同价格提高 170 亿美元，震惊了国会。兩個月後，該供應商的高層將向眾議院和參議院退伍軍人事務委員會解釋為什麼陷入困境的現代化工作的價格再次飆升。聯合執行長 Mike Sicilia 在執行副總裁西瑪·維爾馬 (Seema Verma) 的陪同下，將於週三下午在參議院委員會作證，週四上午在眾議院委員會作證，董事長兼首席技術官拉里·埃里森 (Larry Ellison) 預計將在幾週內（即 12 月 10 日）至少在眾議院委員會作證。
historyItems.originalTitle: Here’s how Congress, stakeholders are preparing for Oracle execs to testify on VA EHRM
historyItems.originalSummary: Two subpoenas and two months after the Department of Veterans Affairs shocked Congress by raising its Oracle Health electronic health record contract price by $17 billion, the vendor’s executives are set to come before the House and Senate Veterans’ Affairs Committees to explain why the price of the troubled modernization effort has ballooned again. Co-CEO Mike Sicilia, accompanied by Executive Vice President Seema Verma, will testify Wednesday afternoon before the Senate committee and Thursday morning in the House committee , with Chairman and Chief Technology Officer Larry Ellison slated to come before at least the House committee in a few weeks on Dec. 10. Sicilia and Ellison were unanimously subpoenaed by the House committee on Sept. 2 when Verma failed to appear before the panel due to “ time constraints and the two panel structure of the hearing.” “Oracle must appear publicly before this committee to answer for its performance and how the additional billions of dollars it will receive will benefit veterans,” House panel ranking member Rep. Mark Takano, D-Calif., said at the time.

historyItems.title: Ondas 和阿斯頓馬丁阿美一級方程式車隊啟動多年合作夥伴關係，旨在“加快決策速度”
historyItems.summary: 自動駕駛系統領域的全球合作夥伴關係將延續至 2029 年拉斯維加斯大獎賽，透過品牌知名度、工程合作和利益相關者參與展示 Ondas 佛羅裡達州西棕櫚灘和內華達州拉斯維加斯 / ACCESS Newswire / 2026 年 11 月 18 日 / 領先的自動駕駛系統提供商 Ondas Inc.（納斯達克股票代碼：ONDS）今天宣布，根據多年合作協議，該公司已成為阿斯頓馬丁阿美一級方程式車隊的全球合作夥伴協議。該關係圍繞著「速度決策」的共同承諾而建立，將成為工程和技術交流、提供切實利益的協作以及與客戶、投資者、合作夥伴和其他利益相關者互動的長期平台。
historyItems.originalTitle: Ondas and Aston Martin Aramco Formula One Team Launch Multi-Year Partnership Built for "Speed to Decision"
historyItems.originalSummary: Global partnership in the autonomous systems sector extends through 2029 Las Vegas Grand Prix to showcase Ondas through brand visibility, engineering collaboration and stakeholder engagement WEST PALM BEACH, FL AND LAS VEGAS, NV / ACCESS Newswire / November 18, 2026 / Ondas Inc. (NASDAQ:ONDS), a leading provider of autonomous systems, today announced it has become a Global Partner of the Aston Martin Aramco Formula One Team under a multi-year agreement. Built around a shared commitment to "Speed to Decision," the relationship will serve as a long-term platform for engineering and technology exchange, collaboration that delivers tangible benefits, and engagement with customers, investors, partners and other stakeholders. Together, the organizations will highlight how rapid innovation, engineering excellence and decisive action drive performance in complex, high-pressure environments.

Built around a shared commitment to "Speed to Decision," the relationship will serve as a long-term platform for engineering and technology exchange, collaboration that delivers tangible benefits, and engagement with customers, investors, partners and other stakeholders. Together, the organizations will highlight how rapid innovation, engineering excellence and decisive action drive performance in complex, high-pressure environments.

historyItems.title: 將實驗室建造的火箭太空船送上火星的燒傷事件
historyItems.summary: 火箭實驗室（NasdaqGS：RKLB）為美國太空總署的雙 ESCAPADE 太空船完成了跨火星注入燃燒，使它們能夠前往火星。作為 ESCAPADE 任務的一部分，該太空船由美國太空總署火箭實驗室和加州大學柏克萊分校設計、建造和營運。成功的自主推進機動將火箭實驗室的工作範圍從運載火箭擴展到為政府客戶提供複雜的深空任務操作。 ESCAPADE跨火星注射燃燒的完成可能是與火箭實驗室更廣泛的風險狀況一起權衡的關鍵因素。
historyItems.originalTitle: The Burns That Sent Rocket Lab-Built Spacecraft to Mars
historyItems.originalSummary: Rocket Lab (NasdaqGS:RKLB) completed trans-Mars injection burns for NASA's twin ESCAPADE spacecraft, enabling their journey toward Mars. The spacecraft were designed, built and operated by Rocket Lab for NASA and UC Berkeley as part of the ESCAPADE mission. The successful autonomous propulsion maneuvers extend Rocket Lab's work beyond launch vehicles into complex deep-space mission operations for a government client. The completion of the ESCAPADE trans-Mars injection burns could be a key factor to weigh alongside Rocket Lab's broader risk profile. We have also spotted 3 warning signs worth knowing about at Rocket Lab. This kind of deep-space contract exposure is not unique to Rocket Lab, and there is a wider peer group to compare against 53 AI infrastructure stocks .

historyItems.title: 葛萊分多計畫：Meta 計畫讓更多學生使用 Instagram
historyItems.summary: 內部 Meta 文件顯示，該公司計劃透過一項名為「Project Gryffindor」的計劃，以學校為目標，提高青少年對 Instagram 的使用。該計畫的重點是在美國發展所謂的“學校社區”，鼓勵青少年將學校橫幅添加到他們的個人資料中，並建立​​一個學生目錄，允許用戶查看學校中使用該平台的其他人並與之聯繫。 Meta 於 2025 年啟動了該計劃，稱其為“學校合作夥伴計劃”，並於 2026 年 9 月大幅擴展了該計劃。該公司表示，當時已有近 17,000 所學校簽署了該計畫。
historyItems.originalTitle: Project Gryffindor: Meta's plan to get more school kids using Instagram
historyItems.originalSummary: Internal Meta documents show the company planned to boost Instagram use among teens by targeting schools in an initiative it named "Project Gryffindor." The project focused on growing what it called "school communities" in the U.S. by encouraging teens to include their school banner on their profiles and establishing a student directory that allows users to see and connect with others from their school who use the platform. Meta launched the initiative in 2025, calling it a "school partnership program," and significantly expanded it in September 2026. The company said almost 17,000 schools had signed up for the program at the time. Meta said the program sought to provide a safer experience on Instagram for children, including protecting them from bullying and online risks by allowing educators to report safety concerns to the company. Another feature gives school-related accounts the ability to post stories and notes visible to all verified students and parents in a school community. Meta said these features would help students and parents stay informed about happenings at school. The announcement gave an example of a school using the Instagram Stories feature to share a notice of basketball tryouts. However, in internal documents prior to the program's public launch, the company discussed more explicitly commercial motivations for establishing school networks. In a 2024 presentation on Project Gryffindor, Meta said that embedding in schools was a way to increase user "acquisition," "friending" and "invites" to join Instagram. Gryffindor is one of the four Hogwarts school houses from the Harry Potter books. "We believe network connections will fuel organic and unattributed acquisition," the project's presentation states, referring to adding new users. "Our current strategy of relying on power user teens to get less active friends onto IG may not be effective if there are full communities of teens that have not yet joined IG," the presentation stated. The previously unreported Meta documents are part of evidence obtained by lawyers through discovery in a multidistrict lawsuit alleging that social media platforms are designed to be harmful to users under 18, and that the companies knew their products carried risks they failed to disclose. Meta, alongside TikTok, Google and Snap, are defendants in the cases, which were brought by children and their families, school districts and state attorneys general.

historyItems.originalTitle: NASA to Cover 35th SpaceX Resupply Mission Space Station Departure
historyItems.originalSummary: NASA is preparing to broadcast the departure of a SpaceX Dragon spacecraft from the International Space Station (ISS). The spacecraft is set to return to Earth no earlier than Wednesday, November 18, after completing its 35th resupply mission. It will carry research samples, equipment, and other cargo back from the station. According to NASA, Dragon is scheduled to undock from the space-facing port of the station’s Harmony module at 11:05 a.m. EST, depending on weather conditions. Ground controllers at SpaceX’s facility in Hawthorne, California, will send the command for the spacecraft to leave. NASA’s live coverage will begin at 10:45 a.m. EST. People can watch the event through the agency’s website and other streaming platforms. The full details are available on NASA’s live coverage page. SpaceX Dragon prepares to return to Earth After 34 days docked to the @Space_Station, the Dragon spacecraft supporting SpaceX’s 35th Commercial Resupply Services mission for @NASA is targeted to undock from the orbiting lab as soon as Wednesday, November 18 → https://t.co/tnMukzSxui https://t.co/OhkzWO1fRh — SpaceX (@SpaceX) November 17, 2026 NASA and SpaceX are watching weather conditions around the planned splashdown area off the California coast. The spacecraft is expected to reach the ocean no earlier than 1:50 a.m. EST on Thursday, November 19. This is 10:50 p.m. PST on Wednesday, November 18. The return schedule may change depending on weather conditions in the recovery area. NASA said it would share updates about the splashdown time on its space station blog. The agency will not provide a live broadcast of the splashdown. Research samples and equipment returning from space The spacecraft will be returning with many kilograms of scientific samples to help scientists on Earth and in space. A 3D printed blood vessel sample was studied to understand age-related disease of blood vessels and the heart. Frozen tumour organoids have also been treated on the station and will be returned to Earth to investigate how cancer treatments can be improved. Microbes, which have been frozen, will be returned to Earth to give scientists insight into how antibiotic resistant bacteria adapt and change in space. Finally, a lighting system which has been on the station for over 3 years will be returned. It was tested to see if it could assist astronauts to get better quality sleep and maintain good health during long missions. A mission that delivered more than 6,300 pounds of cargo A Dragon spacecraft carrying over 6,300 pounds of supplies, scientific experiments and equipment docked with the station on October 15. The craft was carried into space by a Falcon 9 rocket on October 13 from Florida as the 35th resupply mission for NASA and SpaceX. Experiments conducted on the International Space Station, which has been occupied by astronauts for over 26 years, are helping prepare for future missions to the Moon and Mars.

historyItems.title: Microsoft 和 Salesforce 宣布推出 Copilotforce，將可信賴的客戶環境和行動帶入 Microsoft AI 體驗中
historyItems.summary: 華盛頓州雷德蒙德和舊金山 - 2026 年 11 月 17 日 - 微軟公司（納斯達克股票代碼：MSFT）和 Salesforce Inc.（紐約證券交易所股票代碼：CRM）今天宣佈建立 Copilotforce，這是一項新的合作夥伴關係，透過將 Salesforce 客戶環境、業務流程和操作引入 Microsoft Copilot 和其他員工的生產力來完成更多工作體驗，已經使用他們已經完成的工作工具
historyItems.originalTitle: Microsoft and Salesforce Announce Copilotforce, Bringing Trusted Customer Context and Action into Microsoft AI Experiences
historyItems.originalSummary: REDMOND, Wash., and SAN FRANCISCO — Nov. 17, 2026 — Microsoft Corp. (NASDAQ: MSFT) and Salesforce Inc. (NYSE: CRM) today announced Copilotforce, a new partnership that helps employees get more done in the tools they already use by bringing Salesforce customer context, business processes and actions into Microsoft Copilot and other AI-powered productivity experiences. Unveiled at Microsoft Ignite, the partnership introduces new integrations across Microsoft Copilot, Microsoft Teams and Microsoft Fabric, including Salesforce in Copilot, a plugin available in public preview with 38+ prebuilt sales skills. Together, these capabilities help businesses move faster, reduce manual work and get more value from their existing technology investments — while maintaining the security, governance and permissions they already rely on. Read on to learn how Amkor Technology, Inc., Aehr Test Systems and Inc. compare based on key financial metrics to determine which better meets your investment needs. About Amkor Technology, Inc., Aehr Test Systems and Inc. Amkor Technology, Inc. provides outsourced semiconductor packaging and test services in the United States, Japan, Europe, and the Asia Pacific. It offers turnkey packaging and test services, including semiconductor wafer bump, wafer probe, wafer back-grind, package design, packaging, burn-in, system-level and final test, and drop shipment services; flip chip scale package products for smartphones, tablets, and other mobile consumer electronic devices; flip chip stacked chip scale packages that are used to stack memory digital baseband, and as applications processors in mobile devices; flip-chip ball grid array packages for various networking, storage, computing, automotive, and consumer applications; and memory products for system memory or platform data storage. The company provides wafer-level CSP packages for power management, transceivers, sensors, wireless charging, codecs, and specialty silicon; wafer-level fan-out packages used in power management, transceivers, radar, and specialty silicon; silicon wafer integrated fan-out technology that replaces a laminate substrate with a thinner structure; leadframe packages for electronic devices and mixed-signal applications; and substrate-based wirebond packages used to connect a die to a substrate. Further, the company provides wafer, package, and system level test services, as well as burn-in test and test development services. It serves integrated device manufacturers, fabless semiconductor companies, original equipment manufacturers, and contract foundries. Amkor Technology, Inc. was founded in 1968 and is headquartered in Tempe, Arizona. historyItems.originalTitle: Doug's 2026-27 Winter Weather Outlook: How much snow will the DC area get?
historyItems.originalSummary: As a beautiful fall winds down, FOX 5 NY's Nick Gregory is sharing his 2026-2027 winter outlook, which is shaping up to be a lot milder than last season, when nearly 60 inches of snow fell in New York City. JUMP TO: FIRST DAY OF WINTER l ‘SUPER EL NIÑO’ l SNOW TOTAL PREDICTIONSWinter forecasts this year come down to four key indicators: Winter officially begins in the Northern Hemisphere on Dec. 21 with the winter solstice – the day with the least amount of possible daylight and the longest night.El Niño refers to warmer-than-average sea surface temperatures along the equatorial latitude in the Pacific Ocean.It causes an intensified southern jet stream that forces the polar jet stream to retreat further into southern Canada. The results are milder, dry conditions in the northern U.S. and a cool, wetter-than-normal forecast for the southern part of the country.This year, we're experiencing a "Super El Niño," with water temperatures rising to a historic 4.77°F above average, outpacing each of the four previous "Super El Niño" years of 2015, 1997, 1982 and 1877. A strong El Niño winter doesn't automatically mean there won't be snow. It tends to bring more coastal storms along the Eastern Seaboard, but the above-average temperatures mean rain is more likely.El Niño can still cause a variety of outcomes. In 2015-2016, the region saw a total of 31.2" of snow, but 27.5" came from one blockbuster storm in January 2016.Here are the other previous totals:Gregory describes the polar vortex as a high-speed "racetrack wind pattern" that circles the North Pole when stable. If it becomes fractured or weakened, arctic air can spill down into the eastern U.S. The polar vortex weakened in early November this year, which has never happened for as long as forecasters have been tracking it. This is worth keeping an eye on. The North Atlantic Oscillation (NAO) is a pressure oscillation that stretches from the North Atlantic down to the subtropical Atlantic.When in its negative phase, the NAO forms a blocking pattern around Greenland that forces cold air down from Canada, resulting in coastal storms. In the past, this has caused some major snowstorms in the New York City area. In its positive phase, the NAO sees much stronger pressure variation in the Atlantic, resulting in a stronger westerly wind. Cold air stays north, keeping temperatures mild around here. Arctic, or Siberian, snow cover started early this year. In fact, it's already above average. What does that mean? Colder air can more easily travel across the North Pole, disrupt the polar vortex and send more cold air into the eastern U.S. Gregory predicts there will be multiple coastal storms this winter, but with a lower-than-average amount of snow. Since the super El Niño leads to milder temperatures, the storms can vary between snow, ice and rain along the coast. You'll probably have to be well inland to get a good amount of snow this year.Gregory predicts New York City and the nearby suburbs could see 12-20" of snow this year, but he notes that might be too generous, all things considered. historyItems.title: FAA 空中交通地面站調查：HPE Juniper 路由器、Cisco 路由器以及電信網路升級的後果
historyItems.summary: 以下是電信網路升級，涉及從已有 20 年歷史的 Cisco 路由器遷移到現代 HPE Juniper 路由器，從而導致上週五全國範圍內的空中交通地面停止。美國交通部長 Sean Duffy 在接受 CNBC 採訪時表示，上週五，美國聯邦航空管理局 (FAA) 全國空中交通地面站進行了電信網路升級，其中包括從使用了 20 年的思科路由器升級為現代的 HPE Juniper 路由器，現在正將注意力集中在較舊的思科設備上。 「當我們在阿肯色州埃爾多拉多進行其中一次切換時，伺服器或路由器開始淹沒我們的網絡，」達菲週一在談到從舊銅線到光纖的網路升級時說道。
historyItems.originalTitle: FAA Air Traffic Ground Stop Investigation: HPE Juniper Routers, Cisco Routers, And The Aftermath Of A Telecom Network Upgrade
historyItems.originalSummary: Here’s a look at how a telecom network upgrade involving a move from 20-year-old Cisco routers to modern HPE Juniper routers led to the nationwide air traffic ground stop last Friday. The Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) nationwide air traffic ground stop last Friday, which resulted from a telecom network upgrade involving a move from 20-year-old Cisco routers to modern HPE Juniper routers, is now zeroing in on older Cisco equipment, said U.S. Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy in an interview on CNBC. “What happened was as we did one of those switchovers in El Dorado, Ark., that server or that router started to flood our network,” said Duffy Monday of the network upgrade from old copper wires to fiber. “Well, all of the work I had done to put in new equipment, those routers in my system didn’t go down. But we also use a lot of 2001 Cisco servers that went out of commission in 2006. It is those old servers that were flooded and started to give us inconsistency in our network.” At this point, Duffy said, the Cisco server in question has been taken to federal contractor and technology solution provider L3Harris Technologies’ Florida laboratory as part of an investigation into the incident with FAA staff on site. CRN reached out to Cisco for comment but had not heard back at press time. As a result of the network issue, Duffy said the decision was made to “shut down the airspace” until the U.S. could “isolate where the flooding of the network was coming from, remedy it, get the systems working again and get air travel back to normal,” said Duffy. In a press conference on Saturday, Federal Aviation Administrator Bryan Bedford told reporters that the FAA spends a billion dollars a year maintaining and sustaining its 1980s TDMI telco network, which he referred to as a 1G system. “We are constantly replacing 2,000 Cisco 600 routers with Juniper routers,” he said. “So, this is ordinary course-of-business stuff.” Those Cisco 600 routers were manufactured between 2001 and 2006. The upgrade from Cisco routers to HPE Juniper equipment was being conducted by Melbourne, Fla.-based L3Harris, which is under contract with the U.S. government, runs the telecom network. L3Harris, which has been working with the FAA for over 20 years, is now under scrutiny on whether there was a misconfiguration issue with regard to the HPE Juniper router as part of the network upgrade.

historyItems.originalTitle: Mistakes were made in AI data center rollout, Oracle CEO tells Detroit crowd
historyItems.originalSummary: Oracle stock fell approximately 4% during Tuesday’s US trading session as investors assessed a Bloomberg report that HSBC sold roughly $300 million of construction debt tied to Oracle’s Project Jupiter data center in New Mexico at a substantial discount. The transaction, completed several weeks ago but disclosed on November 16, adds to concerns about the financing costs and construction risks associated with Oracle’s expanding AI infrastructure business. Oracle (NYSE: ORCL) traded at $114.34 at 12:05 p.m. ET on November 17, down 3.99% from Monday’s $119.09 close. The shares had already declined 4.99% on Monday, leaving them under pressure as lenders reassessed their exposure to large AI infrastructure projects. According to Bloomberg’s November 16 report , citing people familiar with the transaction, HSBC sold its portion of the $18 billion financing package at prices in the mid-80s, meaning approximately 85 cents for each dollar of face value. The sale followed Oracle’s decision to issue a force majeure notice to the project’s developer, a unit of Blue Owl Capital. historyItems.originalTitle: Oklo roundup: Groves-1 plans, Centrus contract, Aurora concrete
historyItems.originalSummary: Oklo Inc. (NYSE: OKLO) (“Oklo”), an advanced nuclear technology company, today announced it has signed multiple definitive, multi-year contracts with Centrus Energy Corp. (NYSE: LEU) (“Centrus”), a uranium enrichment and nuclear fuel services provider, for high-assay low-enriched uranium (HALEU). Under the agreements, Oklo will make prepayments for future HALEU deliveries to support construction of new U.S. uranium enrichment capacity with Centrus. The agreements formalize the June 2026 letter of intent between Oklo and Centrus and include enough HALEU to support up to five Aurora powerhouses for multiple years, with fuel deliveries from Centrus’ American Centrifuge Plant in Pike County, Ohio, scheduled to begin in 2029.This press release features multimedia. View the full release here: https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20261112814189/en/Oklo's Aurora powerhouse (Image: Oklo)The HALEU purchase is supported by Meta’s prepayment for future Oklo power production and secures fuel for the first phase of Oklo’s planned 1.2 GW power campus in Ohio. Meta’s previously announced agreement with Oklo linked prepayment for power with advancement of project development. With the funding, Oklo is able to advance fuel procurement with Centrus for the planned Ohio campus, which includes multiple Oklo Aurora powerhouses; expand Ohio’s clean energy workforce; and generate new local and state tax revenues through investment in energy infrastructure.The fuel supply marks a major step toward scaling Oklo’s power business beyond its first reactor. Building on Oklo’s allocation of recovered Experimental Breeder Reactor II (EBR-II) fuel for its first Aurora powerhouse in Idaho, the Centrus agreements secure HALEU for the first phase of the Ohio power campus, future Aurora deployments, and later refueling of the Aurora-INL.These agreements and its prepayments will further propel Centrus’ proven centrifuge manufacturing process that recently completed and began shipping its first new centrifuge as part of its domestic uranium enrichment expansion. Centrus has further de-risked its buildout by assembling a complete, unobligated supply chain to serve both the commercial and national security markets. Centrus has now secured $5.4 billion in customer contracts and commitments to purchase LEU and HALEU from the new capacity.“Securing fuel is essential to scaling our power business beyond our first reactor in Idaho,” said Oklo CEO and co-founder Jacob DeWitte. “These agreements support our initial Ohio deployments and provide fuel for future Aurora powerhouses. historyItems.originalTitle: Elon Musk Wants to Merge Tesla and SpaceX. Their Businesses Already Overlap.
historyItems.originalSummary: Thank you for your patience while we verify access. Nearly a decade ago, Elon Musk gave Tesla’s design team an unusual assignment: Build a sports car that can fly. Mr. Musk brought in a small team of engineers from SpaceX, his rocket company, to lend a hand. Led by Bill Riley, SpaceX’s executive overseeing engineering on the rocket intended to land NASA astronauts on the moon, the team juggled their day jobs with outfitting a Roadster sports car with cold-gas thrusters, a technology more commonly found in rockets that has enough force to burst a human eardrum, according to three people familiar with the project. This year, as engineers from both companies prepared for the car’s debut, they spent months putting it through its paces at SpaceX’s rocket testing facility in McGregor, Texas, the people said. In October, a driverless Roadster did a kick flip in midair, launching off a ramp more than 60 feet high. This is “what happens when you have a collaboration with the world’s best car company and the world’s best rocket company” Mr. Musk told the crowd.

historyItems.summary: 作者：Kelly Cloonan Nebius Group 下調了全年收入預期，理由是一些第三方產能的延遲。這家人工智慧雲端公司也解決了最近對其擴建融資的擔憂，強調了其客戶預付款的勢頭。 Nebius 週四表示，目前預計全年收入將處於先前指引 30 億至 34 億美元的下限。 FactSet 調查的分析師預測其營收為 33.5 億美元。
historyItems.originalTitle: Nebius Lowers Outlook, Addresses Worries Over Financing AI Buildout
historyItems.originalSummary: By Kelly Cloonan Nebius Group lowered its full-year revenue outlook, citing a delay in some third-party capacity. The artificial-intelligence cloud company also addressed recent concerns over financing its buildout, emphasizing its momentum with customer prepayments. Nebius said Thursday it now expects full-year revenue to come in at the low end of its prior guidance range of $3 billion to $3.4 billion. Analysts polled by FactSet are forecasting $3.35 billion. The updated guidance factors in a portion of this year's revenue moving into next year, with some third-party capacity Nebius had expected to come online this year now scheduled for the first half of 2027, the company said. The contracts behind that capacity remain in place, the company said. Nebius also gave an initial outlook for next year, guiding for revenue of $12 billion to $13 billion, compared with analyst projections of $12.09 billion. The company said the forecast reflects a conservative approach to the pace of its buildout, and that it continues to expect to bring online more than 1 gigawatt of new capacity each year. "Our focus remains on building a healthy, profitable business for the long term," Chief Executive Arkady Volozh said in a letter to shareholders. The guidance comes amid investor worries over how neocloud companies will finance their growing footprints. CoreWeave, whose borrowing costs have surged in recent weeks and helped spark the market jitters, eased some of those concerns earlier this week after reporting better-than-expected quarterly revenue. Volozh said Nebius is able to finance its buildout in a prudent way through customer prepayments and a healthy balance sheet, helped by a strategy that lets it command premium prices and terms, and bring down its costs of infrastructure from designing and building it itself. Nebius expects prepayments and financing against existing contracts with investment-grade customers to cover 75% to 85% of its capital expenditures in 2027, and has a wide range of other funding options available, Volozh said. "Our confidence in the fundamentals of what we are building has not changed, and the opportunity ahead of us is as large as it has ever been. We will keep going," Volozh said. Nebius shares slid 12% to $136.66 in premarket trading. Nebius reported a third-quarter loss of $37.5 million, or 13 cents a share, compared with a loss of $119.6 million, or 50 cents a share, a year earlier. Revenue surged by more than six-fold to $980.8 million, compared with analyst estimates of $907.2 million. Write to Kelly Cloonan at kelly.cloonan@wsj.com (END) Dow Jones Newswires 11-12-26 0838ET

historyItems.originalTitle: Marvell and Penguin Solutions Collaborate to Address Data Center AI Memory and Accelerate Inference at Scale
historyItems.originalSummary: Marvell Technology, Inc. (NASDAQ: MRVL), a leader in data infrastructure semiconductor solutions and Penguin Solutions, Inc. (NASDAQ: PENG), the AI Factory Platform Company, today announced a strategic collaboration to address AI memory demands. This collaboration brings together two complementary technologies: CXL-based memory expansion that enables data centers to extend server memory capacity using existing DDR4 memory, and advanced photonic technology designed to enable high-bandwidth, low latency memory sharing across multiple racks.As AI workloads shift from model training to large-scale inference and agentic AI, memory capacity, bandwidth, and latency are becoming critical constraints on application performance and token economics. Growing model sizes, longer context windows, and expanding KV-cache requirements are driving memory needs into hundreds of gigabytes and increasingly terabytes per node. These demands are accelerating the shift beyond traditional server-attached memory toward memory expansion, pooling, and disaggregation technologies such as CXL and optical shared-memory fabrics, enabling memory capacity to scale independently of compute.Two Complementary Levels of Memory ExpansionMarvell and Penguin Solutions are developing two complementary memory expansion technologies designed to address AI infrastructure needs at the server and pod levels:Direct-attach memory expansion: The planned addition of Marvell® Structera™ X memory-expansion controllers within Penguin Solutions SMART® CXL AICs enables data centers to unlock additional memory capacity by recycling existing high-density DDR4 memory modules from decommissioned servers and connecting them directly to servers through PCIe 5.0 and CXL 2.0. This approach provides scalable, low-latency memory expansion in a standard form factor designed for broader industry adoption.Multi-rack photonic memory pooling: By integrating Marvell® Photonic Fabric™ optical interconnect technology-based memory modules and NICs into Penguin Solutions MemoryAI™ memory appliances and ComputeAI™ systems, AI data centers will be able to support low-latency, high-bandwidth, multi-rack disaggregated memory sharing across longer distances, enabling petabyte-scale memory pools for context-rich agentic AI inference.These two technologies are highly complementary. Direct-attach memory expansion addresses immediate, server-level capacity needs today, while multi-rack photonic memory sharing is designed to enable high-bandwidth, low-latency memory sharing across multiple racks to support increasingly demanding AI workloads. Together, these approaches are designed to provide customers with greater flexibility to expand memory capacity and scale AI infrastructure as its needs evolve, offering a single upgrade path from direct-attach expansion to disaggregated, multi-rack sharing, without re-architecting their infrastructure at each step.An additional benefit of the standard AIC form factor is its ability to support memory expansion beyond direct server attachment. historyItems.summary: 如果合併後的公司保住特斯拉的席位，SpaceX 可能會透過合併進入標準普爾 500 指數。巴克萊認為最有可能的結果是全股票交易，SpaceX 收購特斯拉，而特斯拉持有者將獲得 SpaceX 股票。馬斯克表示，獨立董事正在處理談判，持有特斯拉所有已發行股票 50% 的持有人需要投下贊成票。
historyItems.originalTitle: TSLA, SPCX Diverge Overnight As Retail Traders Split On Merger Winner — Could SpaceX Get Tesla’s S&P 500 Seat?
historyItems.originalSummary: A merger could give SpaceX a route into the S&P 500 if the combined company keeps Tesla's seat. Barclays sees an all-stock deal as the likeliest outcome, with SpaceX buying Tesla and Tesla holders receiving SpaceX shares. Musk said independent directors are handling the talks and holders of 50% of all outstanding Tesla shares would need to vote in favor.

investorBrief.event: 如果合併後的公司保住特斯拉的席位，SpaceX 可能會透過合併進入標準普爾 500 指數。巴克萊認為最有可能的結果是全股票交易，SpaceX 收購特斯拉，而特斯拉持有者將獲得 SpaceX 股票。馬斯克表示，獨立董事正在處理談判，持有特斯拉所有已發行股票 50% 的持有人需要投下贊成票。
investorBrief.why: 這會直接影響市場對未來營收、EPS 與估值的預期。投資上比已公布的單季數字更重要的是公司接下來的財測方向、毛利與需求能見度。

historyItems.summary: SK 海力士計畫與韓國政府合作於 2027 年開設半導體測試設施，旨在提高該國小型晶片設備製造商的全球競爭力。 SK 海力士週一（11 月 16 日）在一份聲明中表示，這座耗資 8,746 億韓元（6.54 億美元）的設施正在首爾以南龐大的龍仁半導體集群內建造。 Trinity Fab 工廠將於 5 月開業，配備的設備可供中小型供應商在其產品部署到商業晶片生產線之前進行最終性能和產量驗證。
historyItems.originalTitle: SK Hynix Plans Chip Testing Hub to Boost Smaller Korean Players
historyItems.originalSummary: SK HYNIX plans to open a semiconductor testing facility in 2027 in partnership with the South Korean government, angling to boost the global competitiveness of the country’s smaller chip equipment makers. The 874.6 billion won (US$654 million) facility is being built inside the sprawling Yongin Semiconductor Cluster, which is under construction south of Seoul, SK Hynix said in a statement on Monday (Nov 16). The Trinity Fab facility will open in May with equipment that small and medium-sized suppliers can use to conduct final performance and yield validation before their products are deployed in commercial chipmaking lines, it said.

historyItems.title: ULA 遭遇首次徹底失敗，運載 40 顆亞馬遜 Leo 衛星的火神火箭遺失
historyItems.summary: 聯合發射聯盟火神號配備了六個固體火箭助推器，從卡納維拉爾角的 41 號發射台升空。飛行 10 分鐘後發生故障，導致 40 顆亞馬遜獅子座衛星遺失。圖片來源：Michael Cain/Spaceflight Now 聯合發射聯盟遭遇重大挫折，該公司搭載一批亞馬遜 Leo 網路衛星的新型重型火神火箭在周日爬升太空過程中發生故障，導致有效載荷失效，並給兩家公司的發射計劃造成了代價高昂的影響。
historyItems.originalTitle: ULA suffers first outright failure with loss of Vulcan rocket carrying 40 Amazon Leo satellites
historyItems.originalSummary: A United Launch Alliance Vulcan, equipped with six solid rocket boosters, lifts off from Cape Canaveral's pad 41. A failure 10 minutes into flight resulted in the loss of 40 Amazon Leo satellites. Image: Michael Cain/Spaceflight Now In a major setback for United Launch Alliance, the company’s new heavy-lift Vulcan rocket carrying a batch of Amazon Leo internet satellites, malfunctioned during the climb to space Sunday, dooming the payload and throwing a costly wrench into the launch schedule of both companies. “Based on data received by our Launch Director, we confirm that the Vulcan vehicle launched from Space Launch Complex 41 (at the Cape Canaveral Space Force Station) suffered an anomaly 10 minutes into the flight and failed to deliver the Amazon mission to orbit,” ULA said in a statement some 50 minutes after liftoff. “We will work closely with our customer and other appropriate organizations to find the cause, determine the appropriate corrective action and return to flight as quickly as possible.” It was the first outright failure of a United Launch Alliance rocket since the company, a partnership between Boeing and Lockheed Martin, was formed in 2006. It wasn’t immediately known what went wrong, but the Vulcan, the rocket replacing ULA’s fleet of Atlas 5 rockets, will face a potentially significant grounding while engineers review telemetry and implement fixes for whatever caused the mishap. It was only the fifth flight of a Vulcan rocket and the first in nine months as ULA and booster-supplier Northrop Grumman worked to resolve problems with nozzles used by strap-on solid-fuel boosters that marred two earlier flights. The solids appeared to work normally Sunday, helping boost the rocket out of the dense lower atmosphere before burning out and falling away. The two methane-burning BE-4 engines powering the Vulcan’s first stage then continued the climb toward orbit, but they appeared to fire longer than expected based on ULA’s pre-launch timeline. After stage separation, the Vulcan’s hydrogen-fueled Centaur upper stage engines took over for a planned 12-minute 15-second burn. According to ULA’s update, something went wrong during that Centaur firing, but no additional details were immediately provided. Sunday’s launch was the first of 38 Vulcan flights purchased by Amazon to launch its Leo satellites, designed to compete head-to-head with Elon Musk’s Starlinks and other space-based internet providers. ULA already has launched eight LEO flights using Atlas 5 rockets.

historyItems.originalTitle: Firefly Aerospace Inks $1.3 Billion Deal With AST SpaceMobile for Rocket Engines
historyItems.originalSummary: Firefly Aerospace has signed an agreement valued at more than $1.3 billion with AST SpaceMobile to supply rocket engines, license engine intellectual property, and provide engineering support for AST SpaceMobile’s new heavy-lift launch vehicle. The three-year agreement includes the delivery of 36 rocket engines and provides AST SpaceMobile with rights to manufacture engines using Firefly’s technology. The transaction represents a substantial commercial agreement for Firefly and supports AST SpaceMobile’s strategy of developing its own launch infrastructure for satellite deployments. Under the agreement, Firefly will provide 27 Miranda engines and nine Vira vacuum engines for AST SpaceMobile’s first three rockets. The engines will support development of a new heavy-lift launch vehicle intended to deploy AST SpaceMobile’s BlueBird satellites into low Earth orbit. AST SpaceMobile is developing a space-based cellular broadband network designed to provide connectivity directly to standard mobile devices. The company requires substantial launch capacity to deploy its satellite constellation and expand network coverage. Developing its own launch vehicle could provide greater control over launch schedules and reduce dependence on third-party rocket availability. Firefly will supply the propulsion technology while maintaining ownership of its underlying intellectual property. AST SpaceMobile will receive a license allowing it to manufacture the engines for its launch program.

historyItems.originalTitle: Boeing and Philippine Airlines Finalize Order for up to 20 787 Dreamliners
historyItems.originalSummary: Flag carrier plans fleet modernization and network growth with the 787-10 CHICAGO, Nov. 15, 2026 - Boeing [NYSE: BA] and Philippine Airlines this week announced the airline finalized its order for 15 787 Dreamliner jets, with opportunity to purchase five more as demand for air travel continues to grow. The order is Philippine Airlines' largest ever widebody purchase, fulfilling its commitment announced in July 2026. As the largest member of the 787 Dreamliner family, the 787-10 will support the Philippine flag carrier's fleet modernization and expansion plans, adding capacity and efficiency to its medium- and long-haul network. The signing marks another milestone in the 80-year partnership between Boeing and Philippine Airlines. A leading global aerospace company and top U.S. exporter, Boeing develops, manufactures and services commercial airplanes, defense products and space systems for customers in more than 150 countries. Our U.S. and global workforce and supplier base drive innovation, economic opportunity, sustainability and community impact. historyItems.title: SpaceX 歷史性首次捕捉 Starship 火箭上級
historyItems.summary: SpaceX 使用連接在發射塔上的巨型機械手臂成功抓住了火箭的上級，從而在其星際飛船計劃中實現了一個重要的里程碑。太空船在太空停留22.5小時後返回地球，這是首次透過該技術成功回收太空船。然而，這次任務只取得了部分成功，因為火箭的下部未能實現計畫中的回收嘗試。 Starship 完成 22.5 小時的飛行 當地時間週五 16 點 47 分，124 公尺高的 Starship 火箭從 SpaceX 位於德克薩斯州博卡奇卡的 Starbase 發射設施升空。
historyItems.originalTitle: SpaceX catches upper stage of Starship rocket in historic first
historyItems.originalSummary: SpaceX has achieved a major milestone in its Starship programme by successfully catching the rocket's upper stage using giant mechanical arms attached to its launch tower. The spacecraft returned to Earth after spending 22.5 hours in space, marking the first successful recovery of the Ship through this technique. However, the mission was only partially successful, as the rocket's lower section failed its planned recovery attempt. Starship completes 22.5-hour flight The 124-metre-tall Starship rocket lifted off from SpaceX's Starbase launch facility in Boca Chica, Texas, at 16:47 local time on Friday. This was the 15th test flight of the spacecraft and the first attempt to recover both sections of the rocket during the same mission. After reaching space, the upper stage, known as the Ship, deployed 26 satellites for SpaceX's Starlink internet constellation. It subsequently completed 14 orbits around Earth before beginning its return journey. The moment a Starship booster exploded during an attempted landing at SpaceX’s facility today. https://t.co/HoRscWHVH0 — распад и неуважение (@VictorKvert2008) November 14, 2026 &nbsp; How did SpaceX catch Starship? As the Ship approached its launch site, it hovered near the launch tower, where two enormous mechanical arms, nicknamed 'chopsticks', moved into position and secured the returning spacecraft. The arms are part of SpaceX's Mechazilla recovery system, which is designed to catch returning rocket stages instead of allowing them to land on the ground using conventional landing legs. This was the first time SpaceX successfully caught Starship's upper stage. The company had previously demonstrated the technique with its Super Heavy booster, which it had caught on three earlier test flights. What happened to Starship's booster? While the upper-stage recovery succeeded, the mission encountered a problem during the attempted recovery of the Super Heavy booster. The lower section was expected to return to the launch tower approximately six and a half minutes after liftoff. However, an automated abort system cancelled the catch attempt and diverted the booster towards the ocean. The booster hovered above the water before bursting into flames. Elon Musk later said on X that it was "slightly low on fuel". Why does SpaceX want to recover both stages? SpaceX aims to make Starship completely reusable to reduce the cost of launching payloads into space. Recovering both sections would allow the company to inspect, refuel and prepare the rocket for subsequent flights. The approach builds on the company's Falcon 9 programme, whose reusable boosters have helped reduce launch costs. Why is this important for NASA's Moon mission? Starship's development is closely linked to NASA's Artemis programme. SpaceX has a contract to develop a lunar lander based on Starship that could transport astronauts to the Moon's surface. However, the company must demonstrate reliable recovery and repeated operations before Starship can fulfil its ambitious role in future lunar missions.

historyItems.originalTitle: Fluence Energy, Inc. (FLNC) latest stock news and headlines
historyItems.originalSummary: The lawsuit alleges Fluence Energy's fiscal 2026 guidance rested on contract manufacturing facilities that were not ready to produce at assumed volumes. Three heavy-volume selloffs followed as that alleged gap surfaced, and this release measures the market impact of each. NEW YORK , Nov. 12, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- SueWallSt alerts investors in Fluence Energy, Inc. (NASDAQ: FLNC ) of a pending securities class action on behalf of purchasers of Fluence Energy securities between November 24, 2025 and September 16, 2026. Find out if you may qualify to recover losses or contact Joseph E. Levi, Esq. at [email protected] or (888) SueWallSt. FLNC closed at $28.99 on February 4, 2026, and faltered to just $18.95 the following day, a decline of $10.04 per share, or about 34.63%. The complaint highlights two further declines of about $1.02, or 7.17% on August 6, 2026 and of $1.39, or about 15.36% on September 17, 2026. To be considered for lead plaintiff, investors must file by November 27, 2026. The Market Impact of Each FLNC Disclosure Day As averred, the decline unfolded in stages because Fluence Energy reaffirmed its fiscal 2026 outlook alongside the February 4, 2026 results and again on May 6, 2026. The pleading asserts that the Company did not disclose that delivering backlog and recognizing guided revenue depended on new contract manufacturing facilities that were not completed, not operational, or not capable of the assumed volumes. It further asserts that corrective measures at the Company's contract manufacturers were not remediating the production problems. The complaint charges that the August 5, 2026 report, which blamed weaker revenue on "production delays at new contract manufacturing facilities," and the September 16, 2026 update, which cited "continuing supply chain issues affecting the Company's U.S. production," each partially corrected those alleged misstatements. "Fluence Energy shareholders absorbed three heavy-volume selloffs in under eight months, and the complaint alleges each one followed news about contract manufacturing problems that had not been disclosed when guidance was set. historyItems.title: 獨家|與員工一起元測試新的預測市場應用程序
historyItems.summary: Meta (META) 正在與員工一起測試一款虛擬貨幣預測應用程式 Takes，人工智慧編寫的問題針對的是導致其 2020 年預測應用程式失效的精心挑選的成本。免費的 Meta 產品對 Robinhood 零售業務的威脅遠遠超過 CME 的機構期貨專營權，因為它爭奪注意力和日常習慣。 Takes 可能永遠不會發貨，也沒有披露收入，而 Meta 的 $135-145B 資本支出對投資者來說是更大的故事。 2026 年 11 月 13 日晚，Meta Platforms（納斯達克股票代碼：META）員工被要求預測誰將贏得智力問答節目 Jeopardy！
historyItems.originalTitle: Exclusive | Meta Testing New Prediction-Market App With Employees
historyItems.originalSummary: Meta (META) is testing Takes, a play-money prediction app, with employees, and AI-written questions target the hand-picked cost that killed its 2020 Forecast app. A free Meta product would threaten Robinhood's retail engagement far more than CME's institutional futures franchise, since it competes for attention and daily habit. Takes may never ship and carries no disclosed revenue, while Meta's $135-145B capital spending is the bigger story for investors. On the night of November 13, 2026, Meta Platforms ( NASDAQ:META ) employees were asked to predict who would win the quiz show Jeopardy! inside an unreleased app called Takes. The test appeared that afternoon, and Meta declined to comment and gave no launch date.
